title: FinalizeDeliveryResponse
description: Atomic finalize result. Single Reminder deliveries retain reminder/successor. Ordinary recovery summaries expose batch-only bulk effects. Anniversary catch-up exposes the complete covered Reminder set and each generated yearly successor without fabricating per-member Notification attempts.
x-idempotency-invariants: The first successful Anniversary finalize uses the request timezone to project and persist each yearly successor.
After the transaction or journal is committed, replay returns the persisted successor set exactly and does not reproject it when a later request supplies a different timezone.
timezone is excluded from Reminder, delivery, and delivery-attempt identity.
A retryable failure creates no successor.

oneOf.title: AnniversaryCatchUpFinalize
x-finalize-invariants: covered_reminders contains exactly notification.covered_reminder_ids in that order.
For outcome sent, every covered Reminder is sent and fulfillment_delivery_id equals notification.delivery_id.
successors contains at most one future Reminder per recurring template and is empty for retryable failure.
The first committed result freezes successors; an idempotent replay returns those persisted objects even when the replay timezone differs.
